## Load Models & Data

```{r}
library(CPTtorch)
library(ACED)
library(torch)
data(ACED)
data(FullACED)
```

## Build Proficiency Model

Set a canonical order for the proficiency variables.

```{r}
canonicalOrder <- FullACED.omega$Node
profStates <- c("High","Med","Low")
obsStates <- c("Correct","Incorrect")
```

Generate CPTs for the proficiency models.
I will use a shortcut here as I know that all models are Compensatory-Normal with either 0 or 1 parent.
Moreover, alpha = 1 for all of them.

```{r}
profFactors <- lapply(1:nrow(FullACED.omega),\(prof) {
  child <- FullACED.omega$Node[prof]
  parents <- canonicalOrder[sapply(FullACED.omega[prof,canonicalOrder],
                                  isTRUE)]
  tvals <- rep(list(profStates),length(parents))
  if (length(tvals) > 1L) names(tvals) <- parents
  cpt <- CPT_Model$new("CompensatoryGR","Normal",tvals,profStates)
  cpt$child <- child
  if (length(parents) > 0L) {
    cpt$aMat <- torch_ones(1,1,device=CPTtorch_device())
  }
  cpt$bMat <- torch_tensor(matrix(FullACED.omega$B[prof],1,1),
                           device=CPTtorch_device())
  cpt$linkScale <- torch_tensor(sqrt(1-FullACED.omega$R2[prof]^2),
                                device=CPTtorch_device())
  cpt$setProfOrder(canonicalOrder)
  cpt
})
names(profFactors) <- canonicalOrder
```

## Build Evidence Models

We need to use `task2em` to decode which EM goes with which task.


```{r}
evidenceModels <- lapply(1:nrow(FullACED.task2em), \(itask) {
  task <- FullACED.task2em$Task[itask]
  iem <- which(FullACED.task2em$EM[itask],FullACED.QQ$Model)
  parents <- canonicalOrder[sapply(FullACED.QQ[prof,canonicalOrder],
                                  isTRUE)]
  tvals <- rep(list(profStates),length(parents))
  if (length(tvals) > 1L) names(tvals) <- parents
  cpt <- CPT_Model$new("CompensatoryGR","GradedResponse",tvals,obsStates)
  cpt$child <- task
  if (length(parents) > 0L) {
    cpt$aMat <- torch_tensor(FullACED.QQ[iem,paste0("A.",parents)],
                             device=CPTtorch_device())
  }
  cpt$bMat <- torch_tensor(matrix(FullACED.QQ$B[iem],1,1),
                           device=CPTtorch_device())

  cpt$setProfOrder(canonicalOrder)
  cpt
  
})
names(evidenceModels) <- FullACED.task2em$Task
```
